# Murtuza Bharmal

> Go-to-market and product marketing lead. Clinically trained dentist (BDS) with an MBA in
> Marketing. Five-plus years of product launches across consumer electronics and real estate,
> now focused on healthcare, medtech and healthtech. Based in India.

Currently open to product marketing and go-to-market roles in healthcare, medtech and
healthtech, and available for launch and GTM advisory alongside that search.

## Background

- **Clinical, 2013–2020.** Bachelor of Dental Surgery at AMC Dental College & Hospital, then
  general dentistry and patient care, plus 20+ community dental health camps.
- **MBA, 2020–2022.** Marketing, Nirma University.
- **Consumer electronics, 2022–2025.** Senior Specialist, Marketing at Xiaomi India. Retail
  planning for the exclusive channel: smartphone, smart TV and AIoT launches, roadshows,
  ATL and BTL campaigns, and online-to-offline demand generation. 30 store openings in 7 days,
  27% lower branding cost, 50% lower cost per lead, 26% footfall increase, 100K social followers.
- **Real estate, 2025–present.** Go-To-Market Manager at an India real estate developer.
  End-to-end GTM for residential launches: positioning, launch timelines, rollout across
  digital, ATL, BTL and channel partners, pricing and inventory strategy, CRM and funnel
  ownership, leading a team of six.

## Skills

Go-to-market strategy, product positioning, product launches, market research, ICP definition
and segmentation, competitor benchmarking, demand generation, full-funnel performance, CRM and
marketing automation, budget ownership, pricing strategy, sales enablement, digital marketing,
Google Ads and Analytics, ATL and BTL activations, OOH and on-ground branding, event planning,
vendor negotiation, cross-functional leadership, AI-led engagement.

## Recognition

Performance Excellence Award across three consecutive quarters. Special recognition from the
Head of Retail for the Diwali 2023 campaign. Google certified in Fundamentals of Digital
Marketing and in Google Analytics.
